With the companion evicted -- independently possible on a Redis cluster, where putMany() is non-atomic across slots -- the guard took the WARM path and skipped the lock entirely: exactly the state it exists for. Now tests both keys; pinned by a torn-state test that fails without the fix. This was the question I explicitly asked the lanes to check.

Finding 8's fix was DELETABLE WITH THE SUITE GREEN. My sizing test asserted the CONSTANT was > 0, not that it reached Cache::flexible; dropping the 4th argument restored the no-expiry refresh lock and passed all 4 guard tests. Now flows through a flexibleRefreshLock() seam a recording subclass observes.

THE BIGGEST GAP. The today/last_7d seam -- the headline for 2 of 4 filter states -- was pinned by nothing: every double overrode fetchWindowTotal() wholesale. TWO mutants survived all 35 tests: (a) ['deduped']->['successful'], rendering the funnel stage the ticket's Q1 explicitly REJECTED (~28% overstated at org 165), and (b) dropping the viewer timezone from Carbon::parse(), shifting a Chicago viewer's window 5-6h. Split out a runWindowQuery() seam and added UniqueLprCaseClaimsWindowSeamTest; both mutants now die.

A FALSE CLAIM IN MY OWN DOCBLOCK. I wrote that impersonators 'still get the freshest value any sibling card offers within a minute'. Lane 1 verified most siblings route through getCacheTTL() and DO collapse to 10s -- 6x fresher than my 60s floor. Rewritten honestly: it IS a divergence from okf/concepts/impersonation.md, not unprecedented (MissedOpportunityClientGraph hardcodes 15min with no collapse), justified by the 9.3s p99, and needs an okf note post-merge.

Citation error, twice. My original comment credited the FINAL rule to PG-027, which says the REVERSE for zod.public_* (platform-gotchas.md:221 -- verified). My first correction then cited clickhouse-integration.md; the canonical rule is PG-002 plus clickhouse-query-patterns.md:79. Corrected, and the stronger STRUCTURAL reason lane 3 supplied is now recorded: orgs is a JOIN source, so without FINAL a renamed org fans out claims x2.

ac.text: Respects Today / Last 7d / This Month / Last Month

The locked path was NOT browser-verified -- this DB has exactly one entitled org -- and is covered by 6 gating-matrix unit tests plus test_locked_stat_renders_the_placeholder_and_executes_no_query, which asserts the placeholder renders AND that no query is executed. ac.text: Sparkline consistent with existing card styling

The remaining judgment -- whether it reads as one family beside its neighbours -- is human-only and carried to hp-3.

B4: cards() returns 10 entries with unique-lpr-case-claims at index 2.
